# Agentic SDLC Responsibility Matrix

This matrix formalizes the operational envelope for every agent in the 27-agent GitHub Copilot catalog (`.github/agents/*.agent.md`), detailing its assigned SDLC stage, read permissions, write permissions, authorized tools, and mandatory human approval triggers.

---

## SDLC RACI & Operational Matrix

| Agent File & Role | SDLC Stage | Reads | Writes | Authorized Tools | Mandatory Human Approval Triggers |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **`software-engineering-orchestrator.agent.md`**<br/>Software Engineering Orchestrator | Full SDLC Coordination | `.context/**`, Git status, pipeline logs, test reports | Task state transitions, dispatch events, handoff contracts | Agent Dispatcher, State Machine Runner, Gate Validator | Destructive rollbacks, bypassing non-critical gates, manual workflow reassignment |
| **`product-manager.agent.md`**<br/>Product Manager | Product Discovery & Strategy | Market research, stakeholder briefs, customer feedback | `.context/product/**`, PRDs, vision docs, roadmaps | Backlog Tools, Markdown Editor, Roadmapping Tools | Roadmap re-prioritization, feature scope reduction, business-model pivots |
| **`business-analyst.agent.md`**<br/>Business Analyst | Business Process Analysis | PRDs, legacy systems documentation, user interview notes | `.context/requirements/**`, BPMN process models, rule catalogs | Mermaid/PlantUML, BPMN Modeler, Process Flow Designer | Business rule alteration, process compliance exemptions |
| **`requirements-engineer.agent.md`**<br/>Requirements Engineer | Requirements Specification | PRDs, user stories, domain glossary, business rules | `.context/requirements/**`, SRS (`01-SRS.md`), Gherkin acceptance criteria | Gherkin Linter, INVEST Analyzer, Requirements Tracing Matrix | Baseline SRS modifications, deprecation of core functional requirements |
| **`requirements-validator.agent.md`**<br/>Requirements Validator | Requirements Verification | SRS specifications, traceability matrices, acceptance tests | `.context/requirements/validation-report.md`, defect logs | INVEST Quality Checker, Ambiguity Scanner, Completeness Linter | Signing off on GATE-01 Requirements freeze, accepting ambiguous requirements |
| **`solution-architect.agent.md`**<br/>Solution Architect | Enterprise & Solution Architecture | Business requirements, enterprise topology, compliance laws | `.context/architecture/solution-architecture.md`, system boundaries | Architecture Modeler, Context Diagrammer, Cloud Topology Tools | Selecting cloud providers, introducing third-party SaaS platforms |
| **`software-architect.agent.md`**<br/>Software Architect | System Architecture & Governance | SRS, NFRs, system code, domain model, security policies | `.context/architecture/**`, ADRs (`.context/decisions/ADR-*.md`), C4 models | Architecture Modeler, ADR Generator, Dependency Grapher | Core technology stack changes, major architectural pattern shifts |
| **`architecture-reviewer.agent.md`**<br/>Architecture Reviewer | Architecture Conformance | System ADRs, component models, code metrics, dependency graphs | `.context/architecture/review-report.md`, trade-off assessments | Linter for ADRs, ArchUnit, Coupling Analyzers | Approving GATE-02 Architecture signoff, granting architectural exemptions |
| **`hld-designer.agent.md`**<br/>HLD Designer | High-Level Design | Solution architecture, ADRs, component boundary specs | `.context/design/hld/**`, High-Level Design diagrams, subsystem specs | C4 PlantUML, Mermaid diagrams, System Flow Modeler | Introducing new microservices or breaking existing subsystem boundaries |
| **`lld-designer.agent.md`**<br/>LLD Designer | Low-Level Design | HLD specs, domain models, service interfaces, DTO requirements | `.context/design/lld/**`, Class diagrams, sequence diagrams, statecharts | Class Diagrammer, Sequence Modeler, Interface Contract Validator | Synchronous to asynchronous paradigm refactoring, core state machine alterations |
| **`database-designer.agent.md`**<br/>Database Designer | Database Architecture & Modeling | Domain models, storage requirements, query volume profiles | `.context/database/data-model.md`, ERD schemas, normalization plans | ERD Modeler, Normalization Analyzer, Relational Schema Linters | Schema denormalization, partitioning policies, changing primary key strategies |
| **`database-developer.agent.md`**<br/>Database Developer | SQL & Migration Implementation | ERDs, table specs, query profiles, JPA entities | `backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/**`, Flyway DDL, indexes | Flyway CLI, MySQL Workbench, SQL Parser, `EXPLAIN` Query Analyzer | **MANDATORY**: Any `DROP TABLE`, destructive data migration, or unindexed table migration |
| **`api-designer.agent.md`**<br/>API Designer | REST & Interface Governance | LLD contracts, client interaction patterns, security schemes | `api/openapi.yaml`, Swagger specifications, endpoint models | Swagger Editor, Spectral OpenAPI Linter, Mock Server | Breaking changes in existing public REST endpoints, deprecating API endpoints |
| **`integration-designer.agent.md`**<br/>Integration Designer | External Systems & Messaging | API specs, webhook protocols, broker architectures | `.context/design/integrations/**`, messaging schemas, circuit breakers | AsyncAPI Modeler, OpenAPI Spec Tools, Sequence Diagrammer | Introducing new message queues, altering webhook payload retry semantics |
| **`frontend-developer.agent.md`**<br/>Frontend Developer | Angular UI & Client Engineering | Wireframes, OpenAPI specs, Angular components, CSS tokens | `frontend/src/**`, Angular components, templates, SCSS, Karma tests | Angular CLI, Node/npm, ESLint, Prettier, Karma/Jasmine | Modifying primary navigation flow, major npm library upgrades, security header bypass |
| **`backend-developer.agent.md`**<br/>Backend Developer | Spring Boot & Server Engineering | LLD specs, OpenAPI contracts, JPA entities, Flyway scripts | `backend/src/**`, Controllers, Services, Repositories, unit tests | Maven, Java 21 JDK, Spotless, JUnit 5, Mockito | Modifying Spring Security filter chains, altering JWT authentication logic |
| **`ai-engineer.agent.md`**<br/>AI & LLM Systems Engineer | AI/ML & RAG Pipelines | Prompt guidelines, embeddings models, contextual documents | `ai/**`, Prompt catalogs, vector store adapters, LangChain configs | LangSmith, Vector DB Tools, Prompt Linter, Token Calculator | Switching foundational LLM models, increasing inference token cost ceilings |
| **`code-reviewer.agent.md`**<br/>Code Reviewer | Code Inspection & Governance | Git pull requests, diff patches, coding standards, ADRs | Code review line comments, PR approvals, quality scorecards | Reviewdog, SonarQube CLI, GitHub PR Review Tool | Overriding automated static analysis gates, approving PR with open blockers |
| **`test-engineer.agent.md`**<br/>Test Engineer | Test Automation & Verification | SRS acceptance criteria, Gherkin scenarios, API contracts | `tests/**`, integration tests, Playwright/Cypress suites, unit tests | JUnit 5, Playwright, Newman, Karate, Cypress | Waiving test coverage thresholds (< 80%), marking failing tests as ignored |
| **`security-engineer.agent.md`**<br/>Security Engineer | DevSecOps & Security Hardening | Source code, dependencies, Dockerfiles, network rules, IAM policies | Security audit reports, vulnerability fixes, SARIF reports | Semgrep, Snyk, OWASP ZAP, Trivy, TruffleHog | Granting security exemptions for High or Critical CVEs |
| **`performance-engineer.agent.md`**<br/>Performance Engineer | Benchmarking & Load Testing | Latency SLAs, throughput targets, profiling data | Load test scripts, k6 plans, JMeter suites, benchmark reports | k6, Apache JMeter, Async-Profiler, Grafana k6 Cloud | Relaxing P95/P99 latency thresholds, waiving load degradation flags |
| **`devops-engineer.agent.md`**<br/>DevOps Platform Engineer | Build & CI/CD Pipelines | Dockerfiles, build configurations, pipeline triggers | `.github/workflows/**`, Dockerfiles, CI/CD scripts | GitHub Actions, Docker Engine, Podman, Shell Runner | Modifying production CI/CD workflows, modifying container registry secrets |
| **`cloud-engineer.agent.md`**<br/>Cloud & Kubernetes Engineer | Cloud Infrastructure & IaC | Architecture topology, cloud IAM roles, cluster manifests | `k8s/**`, `terraform/**`, Helm charts, Ingress configs | Terraform CLI, Kubectl, Helm, Kustomize | Destroying cloud resources (`terraform destroy`), applying production cluster changes |
| **`release-manager.agent.md`**<br/>Release Manager | Release Governance & Delivery | Release checklists, QA signoffs, security audits, changelogs | Release manifests, Git tags, deployment triggers, release notes | Git CLI, GitHub Releases, Helm Deployer, ArgoCD | **MANDATORY**: Any deployment to Staging or Production environments |
| **`sre-engineer.agent.md`**<br/>Site Reliability Engineer | Reliability & Observability | Telemetry feeds, error rates, APM traces, SLO definitions | Prometheus alert rules, Grafana dashboard JSONs, OTEL configs | Prometheus CLI, Grafana API, LogQL, OpenTelemetry | Altering SLO target thresholds, muting production paging alerts |
| **`incident-manager.agent.md`**<br/>Incident Manager | Incident Triage & Post-Mortem | Production alerts, system logs, incident communication channels | Incident status pages, post-mortem reports (`RCA-*.md`), runbooks | PagerDuty API, Log Collector, Post-Mortem Generator | Closing P0/P1 outage tickets, declaring major incident mitigated |
| **`documentation-engineer.agent.md`**<br/>Documentation Engineer | Technical Documentation | Repository codebase, API specs, schemas, changelogs, architecture | `documentation/**`, `README.md`, developer guides, architecture manuals | Markdown Processor, Mermaid CLI, Docusaurus / MkDocs | Archiving or deleting public documentation portals |
